title: Overview of Carbon Markets and the Potential for Florida Pepper Producers
venue: Proceedings of the Florida State Horticultural Society
abstract: Pepper is an important vegetable crop in Florida. In Miami-Dade County the crop is grown on about 2,000 acres eachyear and sold nationwide as a winter fresh market vegetable. Many pepper varieties are grown in this area, and thenumber is increasing due to market demand (Wang et al., 2021). However, like any other specialty crop, conventionalpepper production generates high environmental risks (Wang et al., 2018) that need to be controlled and reduced,and one of the several available means to overcome these risks is the use of agricultural practices that remove carbondioxide from the atmosphere. Sequestering carbon can help reduce greenhouse gas emissions to the atmosphere andthus mitigate climate change. Several initiatives are allowing farmers and ranchers to generate additional income byadopting management practices that store carbon in soil through carbon credits. A carbon credit is traded globally forgreenhouse gas emissions reductions caused by implementing management practices and is expected to be purchasedby entities and corporations to meet their climate change goals. In the United States, carbon markets are voluntary,and at the present time, there is no universal price for the carbon stored on agricultural lands which implies that pricesare primarily driven by supply and demand like other commodities. However, the current agricultural carbon creditsmarket is not mature and it is difficult to characterize as the available carbon credit programs have different rules,incentives and penalties (Plastina 2021). This paper aims to help extension agents, farmers and ranchers interestedin carbon credit programs better understand how carbon credit and carbon trading will work in Florida. It providesinformation on the market’s mechanisms, specificities and available carbon programs in Florida.
abstract_zh: 辣椒是佛罗里达州的一种重要蔬菜作物。在迈阿密-戴德县，该作物每年种植面积约为2000英亩，并作为冬季鲜食蔬菜销往全国。由于市场需求的增长，该地区种植的辣椒品种很多，且品种数量仍在增加（Wang et al., 2021）。然而，与其他特色作物一样，传统辣椒生产会产生较高的环境风险（Wang et al., 2018），需要加以控制和削减，而克服这些风险的途径之一，是采用能够从大气中吸收二氧化碳的农业措施。固碳有助于减少温室气体向大气的排放，从而缓解气候变化。多项倡议正使农民和牧场主能够通过采用将碳储存于土壤中的管理措施，借助碳信用获得额外收入。碳信用是在全球范围内交易的商品，代表因实施管理措施而实现的温室气体减排量，预计将被实体和企业购买，以实现其气候变化目标。在美国，碳市场是自愿性的，目前农业用地所储存碳的价格并不统一，这意味着其价格主要和其他商品一样，由供求关系决定。然而，当前农业碳信用市场尚不成熟，且难以描述，因为现有的碳信用项目在规则、激励和惩罚机制上各不相同（Plastina 2021）。本文旨在帮助推广人员、农民和牧场主更好地理解碳信用和碳交易将如何在佛罗里达州运作。本文介绍了该市场的机制、具体特征以及佛罗里达州现有的碳信用项目。

title: Assessing the agricultural, environmental, and economic effects of crop diversity management: A comprehensive review on crop rotation and cover crop practices
Costs of Using Cover Crops in Citrus Production, 2022–23
abstract: This publication presents the results from a static one-year cost analysis assessing the viability of planting cover crops in citrus row middles in a Florida grove to determine whether implementing them will be economically feasible for citrus growers. The authors developed a partial budget for cover crops in a typical Florida orange grove, calculating breakeven prices for oranges in terms of price per box (equivalent to 90 lbs of oranges) and price per pounds solids (amount of soluble solids per box of oranges). We also incorporated additional net costs for citrus grove cover crops across historical yield and quality scenarios. Given that cover crops are effective in improving soil quality and suppressing weed growth and have short-term savings in the form of reduced mowing, we believe that the results from our study will benefit citrus growers considering planting cover crops in their grove row middles.
abstract_zh: 本出版物展示了一项静态的一年期成本分析结果，该分析评估了在佛罗里达柑橘园行间种植覆盖作物的可行性，以判断采用覆盖作物对柑橘种植者而言是否具有经济可行性。作者为佛罗里达典型的甜橙园编制了覆盖作物的局部预算，计算了以每箱价格（每箱相当于90磅橙子）和每磅可溶性固形物价格表示的橙子盈亏平衡价格。我们还结合历史产量和品质情景，纳入了柑橘园覆盖作物的额外净成本。鉴于覆盖作物能有效改善土壤质量并抑制杂草生长，且因减少割草而带来短期节省，我们认为本研究结果将有益于考虑在行间种植覆盖作物的柑橘种植者。

title: Cover Crops for Florida Citrus: Practical Considerations and Their Impact on Soil Microbes
abstract: Recently, cover crops (CCs) have regained popularity as interest in soil health and agricultural sustainability increases among growers and consumers. However, their use in perennial agroecosystems and within subtropical climates is less common due to the climatic conditions and management practices of perennial systems. The aim of this publication is to provide Extension agents and growers with practical information to help them successfully cultivate CCs in Florida citrus groves. Written by Emma Dawson, Davie Kadyampakeni, Ramdas Kanissery, Tara Wade, and Sarah L. Strauss, and published by the UF/IFAS Department of Soil, Water, and Ecosystem Sciences, September 2025.
abstract_zh: 近来，随着种植者和消费者对土壤健康和农业可持续性的关注日益增加，覆盖作物（CCs）重新受到欢迎。然而，由于多年生农业生态系统的气候条件和管理方式，覆盖作物在此类系统以及亚热带气候区中的应用较为少见。本出版物旨在为推广人员和种植者提供实用信息，帮助他们在佛罗里达柑橘园中成功种植覆盖作物。本文作者为Emma Dawson、Davie Kadyampakeni、Ramdas Kanissery、Tara Wade和Sarah L. Strauss，由佛罗里达大学/IFAS土壤、水与生态系统科学系于2025年9月出版。

title: Florida Growers’ Perceptions of Adopting Cover Crops in Citrus Production
venue: Proceedings of the Florida State Horticultural Society
abstract: Florida is a leading producer of citrus (Citrus spp.). However, the state’s citrus industry has been devastated by the citrus greening disease [Huanglongbing (HLB)], and production and acreage have almost halved since 2005–06. Cover crops are non-cash crops that are used extensively in row crop production to improve soil microbial activity and organic matter, for nitrogen fixing, and for reducing soil erosion. Given that Florida has sandy soils with low organic matter, citrus growers could benefit from adopting cover crops as healthier soils could improve yields and fruit quality of citrus trees. Cover crop adoption, however, would depend on various factors including potential increases in production costs, profitability, actual tree improvement, and growers’ attitudes toward the practice. In this study we develop a survey that gathers information on Florida citrus growers’ perceptions and attitudes towards cover crop adoption. We collect information on demographics, production practices, conservation practices, and perceptions of cover crops benefits. We use this information to compare perceptions of cover crop benefits and costs, grove characteristics, and the production challenges for adopters and nonadopters. The survey offers insights into uncertainties related to cover crop adoption in perennial fruit production systems that could outweigh the perceived benefits of cover crops among growers. Understanding the factors that affect adoption will provide important insights which could be used by growers, researchers, and policymakers to promote and incentivize adoption of cover crops or similar conservation practices. Our study is the first of its kind to inform about the factors that affect cover crop adoption among citrus growers.
abstract_zh: 佛罗里达是柑橘的主要生产州（Citrus spp.）。然而，该州的柑橘产业已遭受柑橘黄龙病（Huanglongbing，HLB）的严重打击，自2005至2006年以来，产量和种植面积几乎减半。覆盖作物是一类非经济作物，广泛用于行播作物生产，可改善土壤微生物活性和有机质含量，实现固氮，并减少土壤侵蚀。鉴于佛罗里达的土壤多为有机质含量低的沙质土，柑橘种植者可能会从采用覆盖作物中受益，因为更健康的土壤可以提高柑橘树的产量和果实品质。然而，覆盖作物能否被采用，取决于多种因素，包括生产成本的潜在增加、盈利能力、树木实际改善效果，以及种植者对该做法的态度。在本研究中，我们设计了一份调查问卷，收集佛罗里达柑橘种植者对覆盖作物采用的认知与态度。我们收集了人口统计信息、生产实践、保护性耕作措施，以及对覆盖作物效益的认知。利用这些信息，我们比较了采用者与未采用者对覆盖作物效益与成本的认知、果园特征以及生产挑战。该调查揭示了多年生水果生产系统中覆盖作物采用所涉及的不确定性，这些不确定性可能会超过种植者所感知到的效益。理解影响采用的因素，将为种植者、研究人员和政策制定者提供重要见解，有助于推动和激励覆盖作物或类似保护性措施的采用。本研究是首个此类研究，旨在揭示影响柑橘种植者采用覆盖作物的因素。

title: The Use and Impact of Antibiotics in Plant Agriculture: A Review
abstract:
Growers have depended on the specificity and efficacy of streptomycin and oxytetracycline as a part of their plant disease arsenal since the middle of the 20th century. With climate change intensifying plant bacterial epidemics, the established success of these antibiotics remains threatened. Our strong reliance on certain antibiotics for devastating diseases eventually gave way to resistance development. Although antibiotics in plant agriculture equal to less than 0.5% of overall antibiotic use in the United States, it is still imperative for humans to continue to monitor usage, environmental residues, and resistance in bacterial populations. This review provides an overview of the history and use, resistance and mitigation, regulation, environmental impact, and economics of antibiotics in plant agriculture. Bacterial issues, such as the ongoing Huanglongbing (citrus greening) epidemic in Florida citrus production, may need antibiotics for adequate control. Therefore, preserving the efficacy of our current antibiotics by utilizing more targeted application methods, such as trunk injection, should be a major focus.

abstract_zh: 自20世纪中叶以来，种植者一直依赖链霉素和土霉素的特异性和有效性，作为其植物病害防治手段的一部分。随着气候变化加剧植物细菌性流行病，这些抗生素过去已确立的成效正受到威胁。我们对某些抗生素在防治毁灭性病害方面的长期依赖，最终导致了耐药性的产生。尽管植物农业中使用的抗生素仅占美国抗生素总使用量的不到0.5%，但人类仍有必要持续监测其使用情况、环境残留以及细菌种群中的耐药性。本综述概述了植物农业中抗生素的历史与使用、耐药性与缓解措施、监管、环境影响以及经济学问题。细菌性问题，例如佛罗里达柑橘生产中正在流行的黄龙病（柑橘绿化病），可能需要使用抗生素才能得到充分控制。因此，应重点通过采用更具针对性的施用方法（如树干注射），来维持现有抗生素的有效性。[公式：见正文] 版权所有 © 2024 作者。本文为根据CC BY 4.0国际许可协议发布的开放获取文章。

title: Citrus growers’ willingness to pay and perceptions of cover crops
abstract: This study develops and uses a survey to gather information on demographics, production and management practices, and perceptions on using cover crops as a conservation practice from citrus growers and utilizes the double-bounded dichotomous choice contingent valuation method to measure their willingness to pay (WTP) for adopting cover crops in citrus production. The survey is conducted for citrus producers in Florida and Texas. The study finds that, on average, growers from Florida are willing to pay $509.48/acre per year for adopting cover crops. This is substantially less than the WTP for growers in Texas, who are willing to pay more than $1,000/acre per year for cover crops. The study analyzes the factors that have significant impacts on growers’ WTP for cover crops and discusses the heterogeneity in the grower perceptions on the benefits and drawbacks of using this conservation practice by state. Although using cover crops has not been a popular conservation practice in perennial fruit production systems, its potential to improve soil quality is particularly important for citrus production in Florida where soils are sandy and have low organic matter.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过问卷调查，收集了柑橘种植者的人口统计学特征、生产与管理实践，以及他们对使用覆盖作物作为保护措施的看法，并采用双边界二分选择条件价值评估法，衡量他们为在柑橘生产中采用覆盖作物而支付的意愿（WTP）。调查对象为佛罗里达州和得克萨斯州的柑橘生产者。研究发现，佛罗里达州的种植者平均愿意为采用覆盖作物每英亩每年支付509.48美元。这大大低于得克萨斯州种植者的支付意愿，后者愿意为覆盖作物每英亩每年支付超过1,000美元。本研究分析了对种植者覆盖作物支付意愿有显著影响的因素，并讨论了各州种植者对这一保护措施的收益与弊端的认知差异。尽管覆盖作物在多年生水果生产系统中并不普及，但其改善土壤质量的潜力对佛罗里达州的柑橘生产尤为重要，因为该州土壤多为沙质且有机质含量较低。

title: Cost Analysis of Using Cover Crops in Citrus Production
abstract:
Florida has a long association with citrus (
Citrus
sp.) production. However, the citrus industry in Florida has been devastated by Huanglongbing (HLB) or citrus greening disease (
Candidatus
Liberibacter asiaticus). HLB affects the citrus tree phloem and eventually causes tree death. Cover crops, or noncash crops, have traditionally been used in row crop production to improve soil organic matter, for nitrogen fixing, and for weed control. Citrus growers may benefit from adopting cover crops because healthier soils could improve yields and fruit quality of citrus trees. However, growers are uncertain about the costs and benefits associated with cover crop investments. The objective of our study was to analyze whether cover crops represent an economically feasible option for Florida citrus growers. We calculated the break-even prices for ‘Valencia’ and non-‘Valencia’ oranges (
Citrus sinensis
) in terms of price per box (equivalent to 90 lb of oranges in Florida) and price per pound solids per box (amount of soluble solids per box of oranges) by considering additional costs and short-term savings from using cover crops across various yield and quality scenarios based on the past 10 years of data. Considering the short-term savings from adopting cover crops, the per-acre cost of production increased by $107.3/acre or by 5.73% and constituted 5.42% of the total production cost during the first year of adoption. After the 2018–19 peak, the yield and quality for both ‘Valencia’ and non-‘Valencia’ oranges have decreased steadily. Adopting cover crops in the current yield–quality scenario will not be profitable for either ‘Valencia’ or non-‘Valencia’ oranges. However, for ‘Valencia’ oranges, at the median yield and quality levels of 193.5 boxes/acre and 6.08 lb solids/box, respectively, cover crop adoption would be profitable because the break-even price of $2.25/lb solids would be comparable to the market prices of the past 5 years.
abstract_zh: 佛罗里达州与柑橘生产有着悠久的渊源。然而，该州柑橘产业已遭受黄龙病（柑橘绿化病，由亚洲韧皮杆菌引起）的重创。黄龙病影响柑橘树的韧皮部，最终导致树木死亡。覆盖作物（或称非经济作物）传统上用于行播作物生产，以提高土壤有机质、固氮和控制杂草。柑橘种植者采用覆盖作物可能获益，因为更健康的土壤有助于提高柑橘树的产量和果实品质。然而，种植者对覆盖作物投资的成本与收益并不确定。本研究旨在分析覆盖作物对佛罗里达州柑橘种植者是否属于经济上可行的选择。我们以每箱价格（一箱约合90磅佛罗里达橙）和每箱每磅可溶性固形物价格为单位，计算了“瓦伦西亚”（Valencia）橙和非“瓦伦西亚”橙的盈亏平衡价格。计算基于过去10年的数据，并考虑了在不同产量和品质情景下，采用覆盖作物所增加的成本与短期节省。考虑到采用覆盖作物的短期节省，采用第一年的每英亩生产成本增加了107.3美元，即增长5.73%，占总生产成本的5.42%。2018至2019年的产量高峰之后，“瓦伦西亚”橙和非“瓦伦西亚”橙的产量与品质均持续下降。在当前的产量-品质情景下，无论是“瓦伦西亚”橙还是非“瓦伦西亚”橙，采用覆盖作物都无法盈利。然而，对于“瓦伦西亚”橙而言，在产量中位数为每英亩193.5箱、可溶性固形物中位数为每箱6.08磅的情况下，采用覆盖作物将是有利可图的，因为其盈亏平衡价格（每磅可溶性固形物2.25美元）与过去5年的市场价格相当。

title: Factors affecting the bundled adoption of irrigation and nutrient best management practices for improving water quality and quantity in Florida
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: This study focuses on clustering irrigation and nutrient best management practices (BMPs) that help to improve water quality and quantity using a multiple indicator multiple causation model. Data from a survey of Florida growers' irrigation and nutrient practices are used to identify bundles that growers adopt using a cluster analysis. Identified bundles are regressed on grower and farm characteristics. Growers with a college degree or more, income greater than $100,000, greater farm experience, larger operations, organic production, and who produce multiple crops are more likely to adopt the specified practice bundles. Our results can help increase participation in BMPs adoption programs.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用多指标多因果模型，聚焦于对灌溉和养分最佳管理实践（BMPs）进行聚类分析，这些实践有助于改善水质和水量。我们利用佛罗里达种植者灌溉和养分管理实践的调查数据，通过聚类分析识别种植者采用的实践组合。随后，将所识别的实践组合对种植者和农场特征进行回归。拥有大学及以上学历、收入超过10万美元、具有更丰富农业经验、经营规模更大、从事有机生产以及种植多种作物的种植者，更有可能采用特定的实践组合。我们的结果有助于提高BMPs采用项目的参与度。

title: How ecosystem services are measured and why it matters for Florida
abstract: Florida has many ecosystems that are thought of as especially important such as springs, coasts, dry prairies, and the Everglades. One of the ways importance is measured is through value. The term ecosystem services describes the benefits ecosystems and their components provide humans. This publication describes some of the ways to measure ecosystem services and explains how the different approaches to assess ecosystems might be selected, depending on what is most important to the user. This publication should help Extension and outreach agents, as well as agency personnel better understand ecosystem services values and explain them to the public. It should also help interested members of the public who wish to learn more about ecosystem services for themselves.
abstract_zh: 佛罗里达拥有许多被认为尤为重要的生态系统，例如泉水、海岸、干草原和大沼泽地（Everglades）。衡量重要性的方式之一是价值。生态系统服务一词描述了生态系统及其组成部分为人类带来的福祉。本出版物介绍了衡量生态系统服务的一些方法，并解释了如何根据使用者最关心的事项选择不同的生态系统评估方法。本出版物应有助于推广服务人员和机构工作人员更好地理解生态系统服务价值，并向公众加以解释。对于希望进一步了解生态系统服务的公众，本出版物也会有所帮助。

title: The distribution of competitive research grants from the National Institute for Food and Agriculture: A comparison of 1862 land grant universities, 1890 land grant universities, and other institutions
abstract: This article evaluates the U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Institute for Food and Agriculture (NIFA) competitive grant funding awarded to predominately White 1862 land grant institutions (LGUs), historically Black 1890 LGUs, and non‐land grant institutions. We present the historical distribution of funding for agricultural research. Much of the inquiry centers on the differential funding of the 1862 LGUs, 1890 LGUs, and non‐land grant institutions. We discuss the implications for academic and community stakeholders. Results show that, on average, 1890 LGUs and non‐land grant institutions receive less competitive grant funding than 1862 LGUs for the same award programs. We show that the disparity falls from 2010 to 2019.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了美国农业部国家食品与农业研究所（NIFA）授予以白人为主的1862年赠地大学（LGUs）、历史上以黑人为主的1890年赠地大学，以及非赠地院校的竞争性拨款。我们呈现了农业研究经费分配的历史状况。研究的重点在于1862年赠地大学、1890年赠地大学和非赠地院校之间的经费分配差异。我们讨论了这一结果对学术界和社区利益相关者的启示。结果表明，在相同的资助项目中，1890年赠地大学和非赠地院校平均获得的竞争性拨款少于1862年赠地大学。我们还发现，这一差距在2010年至2019年间有所缩小。

title: An Introduction to Florida commodity enterprise budgets: An Extension tool to improve farm financial planning
abstract: Enterprise budgets help farmers and ranchers estimate expenses, potential revenue, and profit. UF/IFAS provides enterprise budgets for a variety of Florida-grown commodities. These are typically built collaboratively by economists, horticulturists and agronomists, ranchers, and growers. This publication highlights key aspects of the enterprise budget as a planning tool for farm businesses. Includes links to UF/IFAS enterprise budgets and related documents specific to several Florida commodities.
abstract_zh: 企业预算帮助农民和牧场主估算支出、潜在收入和利润。UF/IFAS为佛罗里达种植的多种商品提供企业预算，这些预算通常由经济学家、园艺学家和农学家、牧场主及种植者共同编制。本出版物重点介绍了企业预算作为农场经营规划工具的关键要素。文中包含UF/IFAS针对佛罗里达多种商品的企业预算及相关文件的链接。

title: Florida’s Agricultural Carbon Economy as Climate Action: The Potential Role of Farmers and Ranchers
abstract: This article introduces concepts related to carbon sequestration, credits, and markets to help Extension agents, farmers, and concerned residents to better understand how agriculture can help to mitigate climate change, and thus become a part of Florida’s carbon economy. Written by Young Gu Her, Tara Wade, Sawssan Boufous, Jehangir Bhadha, and Michael Andreu, and published by the UF/IFAS Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, May 2022.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了与固碳、碳信用和碳市场相关的概念，旨在帮助推广人员、农民和关心社区的居民更好地理解农业如何助力减缓气候变化，从而融入佛罗里达的碳经济。本文由Young Gu Her、Tara Wade、Sawssan Boufous、Jehangir Bhadha和Michael Andreu撰写，由佛罗里达大学/IFAS农业与生物工程系于2022年5月出版。

title: The Potential for Increased Emissions Due to the Electronic Logging Device Mandate
abstract: Transportation accounts for only 11% of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the life cycle of food but dominates food system conversations. We use national data from the 2017 Commodity Flow Survey to explore the tension between transportation, environmental, and agri‐food policies to understand the potential impact of the Electronic Logging Device (ELD) mandate on agri‐food transportation. We estimate the change in transportation time and energy use resulting from the ELD mandate's efforts to better enforce existing transportation regulations. Our analysis finds that there will likely be an increase in resulting GHG emissions, which may alter the sustainability of on‐road agri‐food transportation.
abstract_zh: 交通运输仅占食品全生命周期温室气体（GHG）排放的11%，但却主导着食品系统的相关讨论。我们利用2017年商品流量调查的全国数据，探讨了交通运输、环境和农业食品政策之间的张力，以了解电子记录仪（ELD）强制性规定对农业食品运输可能产生的影响。我们估计了ELD强制性规定在加强执行现有运输法规的过程中，所带来的运输时间和能源消耗变化。分析发现，温室气体排放很可能随之增加，这可能会改变公路农业食品运输的可持续性。

title: Water Quality Credit Trading: General Principles
abstract: Protection of the quality of Florida water resources is an important priority for the public and the government agencies (Figure 1). Pollution of surface water (e.g., lakes, rivers, and streams) can be linked to fish kills, changes in the color and aesthetic appeal of the resource, changes in the quality of habitat for aquatic plant and animal life (leading to changes in the plant and animal communities), and to human health issues. To address the pollution problems, a variety of programs is implemented at the federal, state, and local levels. Despite these programs, water quality problems persist. A recent FDEP water quality assessment report shows that the concentration of nitrogen in surface water is increasing in some Florida regions, and most assessed rivers, streams, canals, lakes, and estuaries were not meeting surface water quality standards (FDEP 2016). Although there have been gains in pollution reduction, reducing pollution and improving water quality is still a public policy objective in Florida. Costs to implement Florida's water policy objective will be borne by Florida citizens and businesses. Market-based programs, such as water quality credit trading, can provide environmental benefits at lower costs and more quickly than other policy instruments (Shortle 2013). In this document, we review the basic components of a water quality credit trading program and discuss opportunities and challenges associated with a water quality credit trading program design. Technical terms used in this publication are bolded, and a glossary is available at the end of the document.
abstract_zh: 保护佛罗里达州的水资源质量，是公众和政府机构的一项重要优先事项（图1）。地表水（如湖泊、河流和溪流）的污染，可能导致鱼类死亡、水体颜色和美观度的改变、水生动植物栖息地质量的下降（进而导致动植物群落的变化），并可能引发人类健康问题。为应对污染问题，联邦、州和地方各级政府实施了多种项目。尽管如此，水质问题依然存在。佛罗里达州环境保护局（FDEP）近期的水质评估报告显示，佛罗里达部分地区地表水中的氮浓度正在上升，且大多数经过评估的河流、溪流、运河、湖泊和河口未能达到地表水质量标准（FDEP 2016）。尽管在减少污染方面已取得进展，但减少污染、改善水质仍是佛罗里达州的一项公共政策目标。实现佛罗里达州水政策目标的成本将由该州的公民和企业承担。以市场为基础的项目，如水质信用交易，相比其他政策工具，能够以更低的成本、更快地带来环境效益（Shortle 2013）。在本文中，我们回顾了水质信用交易项目的基本组成部分，并讨论了该类项目设计中的机遇与挑战。本出版物中的专业术语以粗体标示，文末附有术语表。

title: Welfare impacts of conservation agriculture adoption on smallholder maize farmers in South Africa
abstract: Climate change and soil degradation are the issues depleting the soil's ability to promote good yield. One of the ways to combat this is the practice of conservation agriculture (CA). This study was carried out to explore and investigate the impact of CA. Multinomial endogenous switching regression model and cross-sectional data were used to investigate the determinants and the impact of the adoption of CA on the income of smallholder maize farmers in Mpumalanga Province, South Africa. Three categories of CA (minimum tillage, crop diversification and a combination of both minimum tillage and crop diversification) were considered. The empirical results revealed that regardless of the choices of CA practices adopted by the maize farmers, the income realized was higher for adopters than for non-adopters of CA practices. The average treatment effect for the adopters of both minimum tillage and crop diversification was the highest, showing an increase in income by 60.31% (R15575.99/$996.57USD) compared to the non-adopters. The policy implication for these results is that there is a need to promote the adoption of CA practices, particularly a combination of both minimum tillage and crop diversification, given their significant impact on farmer income, an important welfare outcome that has significant implications on food security and poverty alleviation.
abstract_zh: 气候变化和土壤退化正在削弱土壤促进高产的能力。应对这一问题的方法之一是保护性农业（CA）。本研究旨在探讨并考察保护性农业的影响。我们利用多项内生转换回归模型和截面数据，研究南非姆普马兰加省小农玉米种植户采用保护性农业的决定因素及其对收入的影响。保护性农业分为三类（少耕、作物多样化，以及少耕与作物多样化相结合）。实证结果表明，无论玉米种植户选择何种保护性农业做法，采用者的收入均高于未采用者。同时采用少耕和作物多样化的采用者，其平均处理效应最高，与未采用者相比，收入增加了60.31%（15,575.99兰特/996.57美元）。该结果的政策含义是，有必要推广保护性农业的采用，特别是少耕与作物多样化相结合的做法，因为这对农户收入具有显著影响，而农户收入是一项重要的福利指标，对粮食安全和减贫具有重要意义。

title: Nitrogen Fertilization Guidelines for Potato Production in Florida
Past, present, and future: Status of women and minority faculty in agricultural and applied economics
abstract: As with many academic fields in the United States, white male faculty have historically been the norm in the agricultural and applied economics profession, but demographics in the field have started to shift over the past several decades. This paper presents descriptive evidence of the current and historical status of underrepresented and historically underserved groups in our profession, including white women and racial and ethnic minorities of all genders. It also provides a snapshot of perceptions of departmental climate, data on incidents of harassment and discrimination in our profession, motivations for switching academic institutions, and finally, data on strategies for retaining faculty from diverse groups.
abstract_zh: 与美国许多学术领域一样，白人男性教师在农业与应用经济学专业中历来是常态，但过去几十年来，该领域的人口结构已开始转变。本文提供了描述性证据，展示了我们专业中代表性不足和历史上处于弱势地位群体的现状与历史状况，包括白人女性以及各性别的少数族裔和少数民族。本文还提供了关于系所氛围感知、骚扰与歧视事件数据、更换学术机构的动机，以及留住不同背景教师策略数据的概览。

Our special focus is freshwater-based recreation. Specifically, studies examining the “economic contribution” or “economic impact” of recreation activities around various natural sites are discussed. Interested reader can pick and choose the studies most relevant to his/her area of interests or those discussing recreational sites nearby.https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1065

title: Economic Value of Florida Water Resources: Valuing the Quality of Water for Household Needs
abstract: Florida water-resource professionals deciding whether to implement a costly water protection program or to invest in better tap water treatment technology may wonder: Are such investments justified? What are the benefits of the program or investment decision? Just how highly do Floridians value their water? This 5-page fact sheet written by Tatiana Borisova, Syed Irfan Ali Shah, Tara Wade, Xiang Bi, and Kelly Grogan and published by the UF/IFAS Food and Resource Economics Department reviews studies that help assess the value Floridians assign to maintaining or improving the quality of the water supply. http://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1059
abstract_zh: 佛罗里达的水资源专业人员在决定是否实施成本高昂的水资源保护项目，或是否投资于更好的自来水处理技术时，可能会产生疑问：这些投资是否合理？决策的效益是什么？佛罗里达人究竟有多看重他们的水资源？这份5页的简介由Tatiana Borisova、Syed Irfan Ali Shah、Tara Wade、Xiang Bi和Kelly Grogan撰写，由佛罗里达大学/IFAS食品与资源经济系出版，对有助于评估佛罗里达人为维持或改善供水质量所赋予价值的研究进行了回顾。http://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1059

Valuing Florida Water Resources: Households’ Willingness to Pay for Water Availability
abstract: This paper is a part of the EDIS series “Economic Value of Florida Water Resources”. As the other papers in the series discuss, water resources provide us with a variety of goods and services (often referred to as ecosystem services). This paper discusses another ecosystem service that Florida water resources provide: water supply for households needs. In this article, we present several examples of valuing water availability found in literature and focused on Florida and other regions.
abstract_zh: 本文是EDIS系列“佛罗里达水资源的经济价值”的一部分。正如该系列的其他文章所讨论的，水资源为我们提供了多种商品和服务（通常被称为生态系统服务）。本文讨论了佛罗里达水资源提供的另一项生态系统服务：满足家庭需求的供水。在本文中，我们列举了文献中若干关于水资源可获得性估值的案例，这些案例既涉及佛罗里达，也涉及其他地区。

title: Valuing Florida Water Resources: Prices of Waterfront Properties
abstract:
This 9-page fact sheet written by Tatiana Borisova, Xiang Bi, Tara Wade, and Kurt Oehlbeck and published by the UF/IFAS Food and Resource Economics Department explores the relationship between water quality and sale prices of waterfront properties, that is, the amenity value provided by water resources to waterfront communities. Being near to water to water generally increases the value of a residential property. However, poor water quality may decrease waterfront property prices. In other words, investments in restoring water quality can translate into increases in property value and tax collection. https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1062

这份9页的简介由Tatiana Borisova、Xiang Bi、Tara Wade和Kurt Oehlbeck撰写，由佛罗里达大学/IFAS食品与资源经济系出版，探讨了水质与滨水房产售价之间的关系，即水资源为滨水社区提供的舒适性价值。靠近水域通常会提高住宅物业的价值，然而，水质较差则可能降低滨水房产的价格。换言之，对水质恢复的投资，可以转化为房产价值的提升和税收的增加。https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1062

It explains three values people assign to water resources and presents a brief overview of the methods that economists employ to measure the value of water. https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/fe1064

Preserving native grassland: Can Sodsaver reduce cropland conversion?
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Native grassland or “native sod”—grassland that has never been tilled for crop production—can provide high-quality habitat for a number of species, including grassland birds, breeding waterfowl, and pollinators. Much of the grassland that once dominated the Midwest and Plains states between the Mississippi River and the Rocky Mountains has already been lost or severely fragmented, reducing its value as habitat (Connor et al. 2002). Once lost, these grasslands are difficult and costly to restore (Loesch et al. 2012). In recent years, attention to the loss of grassland in the northern Great Plains, particularly in the Prairie Pothole Region (PPR), has grown as a number of researchers have documented the conversion of grass to crop production (Wright and Wimberly 2013; Larkin et al. 2015; Doherty et al. 2013), although data used in these studies do not distinguish native sod from other grasslands.
abstract_zh: 原生草地或“原生草皮”，即从未被耕作用于作物生产的草地，能够为多种物种提供高质量的栖息地，包括草地鸟类、繁殖期的水禽和传粉昆虫。曾经主导密西西比河与落基山脉之间中西部和平原各州的大片草地，大部分已经消失或严重破碎化，从而降低了其作为栖息地的价值（Connor et al. 2002）。这些草地一旦消失，恢复起来既困难又昂贵（Loesch et al. 2012）。近年来，北部大平原，特别是草原湖区（PPR）草地的减少日益受到关注，多位研究者记录了草地向作物生产的转化（Wright and Wimberly 2013；Larkin et al. 2015；Doherty et al. 2013），不过这些研究所使用的数据无法区分原生草皮与其他草地。

title: Conservation Compliance: How Farmer Incentives Are Changing in the Crop Insurance Era
abstract: Conservation Compliance ties eligibility for most Federal farm program benefits to soil and wetland conservation. To be eligible for farm program benefits, farmers must apply an approved soil conservation system on highly erodible cropland (Highly Erodible Land Conservation, or HELC) and refrain from draining wetlands (Wetland Conservation, or WC). Conservation Compliance is effective when the incentive—the farm program benefits that could be lost due to noncompliance—exceeds the cost of meeting soil and wetland conservation requirements. HELC significantly reduced soil erosion on highly erodible cropland and may have also encouraged erosion reduction on land not subject to HELC. Compliance incentives (farm program benefits) under the Agricultural Act of 2014 are found to (1) vary widely across farms with cropland in HEL (highly erodible land) fields, (2)approximate the overall level of incentive that would have been provided under an extension of the 2008 Farm Act (although incentives changed significantly on many farms), and (3) be significantly lower on many farms if crop insurance premium subsidies were not subject to Conservation Compliance. Compliance incentives for WC, although measured only in the Prairie Pothole region of the Northern Plains, are clearly larger than Compliance costs for an estimated 75 percent of wetlands that are already cropped or have characteristics (e.g., productivity, topography) that are favorable to crop production.
abstract_zh: “保护合规”（Conservation Compliance）将大多数联邦农业项目福利的资格与土壤和湿地保护挂钩。农户要获得农业项目福利，必须在高度易蚀耕地（高度易蚀土地保护，即HELC）上采用经批准的水土保持体系，并且不得排干湿地（湿地保护，即WC）。当激励措施（即因不合规可能失去的农业项目福利）超过满足土壤和湿地保护要求的成本时，保护合规才是有效的。HELC显著减少了高度易蚀耕地的土壤侵蚀，并可能还促进了非HELC土地上的侵蚀减少。研究发现，《2014年农业法案》下的合规激励（农业项目福利）：（1）在拥有高度易蚀耕地（HEL）地块的农场之间差异很大；（2）与将2008年《农业法》延长实施所能提供的总体激励水平大致相当（尽管许多农场的激励已发生显著变化）；（3）若作物保险保费补贴不受保护合规约束，则在许多农场上会显著降低。对于WC的合规激励，仅在北部平原的草原湖区进行了测算，但对于估计75%已经耕作或具有适合作物生产特征（如生产力、地形）的湿地而言，其合规激励明显高于合规成本。

title: Aggregated Choice Data And Logit Models: Application To Environmental Benign Practices Of Conservation Tillage By Farmers In The State Of Iowa
Using the logit model with aggregated choice data in estimation of Iowa corn farmers’ conservation tillage subsidies
abstract: This study estimates the costs of adoption of conservation tillage by Iowa corn farmers by utilizing the method of empirical estimation of a logit model that incorporates the full information on the attributes of agents and county aggregated measures of agents’ choices. The methodology treats the aggregated data as an expected value—the area-weighted group average of individual probabilities of choosing conservation tillage—subject to a measurement error. Using the 2002 and 2004 county-average conservation tillage choice data, we estimate field level costs of the adoption of conservation tillage and predict that the sample average subsidy payment required to entice farmers to use conservation tillage is $17.65/acre. The results indicate that conservation tillage adoption is significantly affected by soil characteristics, crop choice and high net returns using conventional tillage methods.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用一种logit模型的经验估计方法，估算了爱荷华州玉米种植户采用保护性耕作的成本。该方法纳入了行为主体属性的完整信息以及县级汇总的行为选择指标。该方法将汇总数据视为期望值，即个体选择保护性耕作概率的按面积加权的群体平均值，并假设其存在测量误差。利用2002年和2004年县级平均保护性耕作选择数据，我们估计了采用保护性耕作的田块层面成本，并预测使农户愿意使用保护性耕作所需的样本平均补贴支付为每英亩17.65美元。结果表明，保护性耕作的采用受到土壤特征、作物选择以及采用常规耕作方法所带来的较高净收益的显著影响。

title: Using Expectation Methods To Estimate A Discrete Choice Model When Individual Choices Are Not Observable: Methodology And Applications To Tillage Choice
